notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been removed.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: You do not have permission to view this page. Please contact your system administrator if you need access.

REQUEST.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some input is invalid. Please check and try again.
REQUEST.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
REQUEST.IP_NOT_ALLOWED: Requests from this IP address are not allowed.

UOM.DUPLICATE_CODE: This unit code is already in use in the current company.

UOM_CONVERSION.NOT_FOUND: Conversion not found in the current company.

ITEM_BRAND.DUPLICATE_CODE: This brand code is already in use in the current company.
ITEM_BRAND.NOT_FOUND: Brand not found in the current company.
ITEM_BRAND.IN_USE: Items use this brand. Deactivate it instead.

ITEM_CATEGORY.DUPLICATE_CODE: This category code is already in use in the current company.
ITEM_CATEGORY.NOT_FOUND: Category not found in the current company.
ITEM_CATEGORY.INVALID_PARENT: The parent must be an active category of the current company.
ITEM_CATEGORY.CYCLE: A category cannot be moved under itself or one of its subcategories.
ITEM_CATEGORY.TOO_DEEP: Item categories can have at most 5 levels.
ITEM_CATEGORY.HAS_CHILDREN: This category has subcategories. Move or delete them first.
ITEM_CATEGORY.IN_USE: Items use this category. Deactivate it instead.

ITEM.DUPLICATE_CODE: This item code is already in use in the current company.
ITEM.NOT_FOUND: Item not found in the current company.
ITEM.BASE_UOM_LOCKED: This item has its own unit conversions. Delete them before changing the base unit.

ITEM_UOM_CONVERSION.DUPLICATE: This item already has a conversion for the unit.

WAREHOUSE.DUPLICATE_CODE: This warehouse code is already used in this company.
WAREHOUSE.NOT_FOUND: Warehouse not found in the current company.
WAREHOUSE.HAS_LOCATIONS: This warehouse still has storage locations. Delete them first.

STORAGE_LOCATION.DUPLICATE_CODE: This location code is already used in this warehouse.
STORAGE_LOCATION.NOT_FOUND: Storage location not found in this warehouse.
STORAGE_LOCATION.WAREHOUSE_INACTIVE: The warehouse is inactive, so locations cannot be added.

CURRENCY.DUPLICATE_CODE: This company already uses the currency code.
CURRENCY.NOT_FOUND: The currency was not found in the current company.
CURRENCY.BASE_LOCKED: Exchange rates already exist, so the base currency cannot be changed.
CURRENCY.BASE_REQUIRED: Mark another currency as base instead of clearing the base currency.
CURRENCY.BASE_INACTIVE: The base currency must be active.
CURRENCY.IS_BASE: The base currency cannot be deleted.
CURRENCY.IN_USE: The currency has exchange rates. Deactivate it instead.

EXCHANGE_RATE.OVERLAP: The period overlaps another exchange rate of this currency.
EXCHANGE_RATE.NOT_FOUND: The exchange rate was not found.
EXCHANGE_RATE.BASE_CURRENCY: The base currency has no exchange rate.
EXCHANGE_RATE.NO_BASE_CURRENCY: Set the base currency before adding exchange rates.
EXCHANGE_RATE.CURRENCY_INACTIVE: The currency is inactive, so rates cannot be added.

TAX_CODE.DUPLICATE_CODE: This company already uses the tax code (including deleted ones).
TAX_CODE.NOT_FOUND: The tax code was not found in the current company.
TAX_CODE.IN_USE: The tax code has tax rates. Deactivate it instead.

TAX_RATE.OVERLAP: The period overlaps another rate of this tax code.
TAX_RATE.NOT_FOUND: No tax rate covers this date, or the rate was deleted.
TAX_RATE.TAX_CODE_INACTIVE: The tax code is inactive, so rates cannot be added.
TAX_RATE.DIRECTION_MISMATCH: This tax code does not apply to the chosen direction.

ACCOUNT.DUPLICATE_CODE: This company already uses the account code (including deleted ones).
ACCOUNT.NOT_FOUND: The account was not found in the current company.
ACCOUNT.INVALID_PARENT: The parent must be an active account of the current company.
ACCOUNT.CODE_PREFIX: A subaccount code must start with the parent code and be longer.
ACCOUNT.TYPE_MISMATCH: A subaccount must have the same type as its parent.
ACCOUNT.PARENT_IN_USE: The parent account has been used, so it cannot get subaccounts.
ACCOUNT.HAS_ACTIVE_CHILDREN: Deactivate the subaccounts before deactivating this account.
ACCOUNT.PARENT_INACTIVE: The parent account is inactive. Activate it first.
ACCOUNT.HAS_CHILDREN: This account has subaccounts. Delete them first.
ACCOUNT.IN_USE: The account has been used, so its normal balance cannot change and it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
ACCOUNT.NOT_POSTABLE: The account has subaccounts. Post to a subaccount instead.

AUTH.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Incorrect username or password. Five failed attempts lock the account for 15 minutes.
AUTH.CAPTCHA_INVALID: The verification code is wrong or has expired. Please try again.
AUTH.PASSWORD_EXPIRED: Your password has expired. Change it now.
AUTH.PASSWORD_REUSED: The new password must differ from the current password.

COMPANY.DUPLICATE_CODE: This company code is already in use.
COMPANY.NOT_FOUND: Company not found, or you are not authorized to manage it.

BRANCH.DUPLICATE_CODE: This branch code is already in use in the current company.

DEPARTMENT.DUPLICATE_CODE: This department code is already in use in the current company.

USER.DUPLICATE: This username is already taken (case-insensitive, including users of other companies).
USER.SELF_DEACTIVATION: You cannot deactivate your own account.
USER.SELF_ROLE_CHANGE: You cannot change your own roles. Ask another administrator.
USER.NOT_FOUND: User not found. It may no longer belong to the current company.

AUTHORITY.FULL_ACCESS_REQUIRED: This change affects other companies. You need a full-access role in every affected company.

ROLE.BEYOND_AUTHORITY: This role or user has permissions beyond your own, so you cannot grant, remove or manage it.
ROLE.DUPLICATE_CODE: This role code is already in use (including deleted roles).
ROLE.IN_USE: This role is still assigned to users and cannot be deleted. Remove the assignments or deactivate it instead.
ROLE.NOT_FOUND: Role not found. It may have been deleted.

IP_WHITELIST.NOT_FOUND: IP rule not found. Reload and try again.
IP_WHITELIST.DUPLICATE: This IP range already exists for this target.

NUMBER_RULE.DUPLICATE_TYPE: A number rule already exists for this document type in the current company.
NUMBER_RULE.NOT_FOUND: Number rule not found. It may belong to another company.
NUMBER_RULE.IN_USE: Numbers have been issued with this rule: the date format and reset period are locked and the sequence length cannot be shortened.
NUMBER_RULE.SEQUENCE_EXHAUSTED: All sequence numbers of this period have been used. Increase the sequence length.

APPROVAL_FLOW.DUPLICATE_TYPE: An approval flow already exists for this document type in the current company.
APPROVAL_FLOW.NOT_FOUND: The approval flow was not found. It may belong to another company.

APPROVAL_DELEGATION.OVERLAP: This user already has an active delegate in this period. Periods cannot overlap.
APPROVAL_DELEGATION.NOT_FOUND: The approval delegate was not found. It may belong to another company.

APPROVAL.NOT_FOUND: The approval was not found. It may belong to another company.
APPROVAL.NOT_PENDING: This approval has already been completed or withdrawn. Please refresh.
APPROVAL.NOT_APPROVER: You are not an approver (or delegate) of the current step.
APPROVAL.SELF_APPROVAL: You cannot approve a document you submitted.

COMPANY_IMAGE.NOT_FOUND: The image was not found. It may have been deleted. Reload and try again.
COMPANY_IMAGE.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: Only PNG and JPEG images are accepted. The file content must match.
COMPANY_IMAGE.TOO_LARGE: The image must not exceed 1 MB.
COMPANY_IMAGE.INVALID_DIMENSIONS: The image width and height must be 16–2048 pixels.
